stem: A 12-hour-old female newborn presents with mild jaundice. Hematocrit is 30%, microbilirubin is 18 mg/dL, and her blood group is A (mother's blood group is O). Reticulocyte count is 15%. The direct antiglobulin test (DAT) is mildly positive. What is the appropriate management?

stem: A newborn is delivered from a mother at 32 weeks of gestation with no antenatal care and prolonged rupture of membranes for 24 hours. The mother received inadequate intrapartum antibiotics. On physical examination, the body temperature is 36.5 °C and the infant appears well. Besides CBC, which additional investigation should be sent?
opts: CRP · Hemoculture · Hemoculture and urine culture · Hemoculture and CRP · Hemoculture, urine culture, and lumbar puncture
key: B Hemoculture (ผู้จดวง/ไฮไลต์ไว้ในไฟล์ติว)
why: Early-onset sepsis  (<72 ชม. / <6 วัน): vertical-ascending จาก GI/GU แม่ · GBS, Listeria monocytogenes, gram-negative enteric (E. coli) · Ix: CBC,  hemoculture  ± serial CRP (6, 12, 24 ชม.), CXR ถ้ามีอาการทางหายใจ, ± LP · ยา  ampicillin + gentamicin , Late-onset sepsis  (>72 ชม. / >6 วัน): horizontal (nosocomial/สิ่งแวดล้อม) · CoNS, S. aureus, GBS, E. coli, herpes · Ix: CBC, hemoculture,  urine culture, LP , CXR ถ้ามีอาการ · ยา cefotaxime + ampicillin (สงสัย Listeria), cefotaxime + amikacin, vancomycin + aminoglycoside (อยู่ รพ.นาน/มี catheter),Risk factors (สไลด์): maternal fever
